name: hermes_cli_plugins_cmd_resolve_git_url
notes: Plugin-identifier -> git-URL resolver (src/hermes_cli/plugins_cmd_wrappers.c::pcmd_resolve_git_url vs LIVE hermes_cli/plugins_cmd.py::_resolve_git_url). FIXED THE PORT before gating: the old C was a two-line stub (pass URLs through, prefix everything else with https://github.com/<id>.git) with NO subdirectory support, no GitHub browser-tree handling, no #fragment or .git/ boundary. Rewritten to the full LIVE ladder including out_subdir; invalid identifiers return NULL mirroring LIVE's ValueError. Cup = branch ladder + VSTR('url|subdir').
